scope: Home routing-panel overflow fix; source review only, no Cargo build or native UI acceptance
source_checks: Confirmed egui 0.34.3 Panel::bottom, Panel::exact_size, and Frame::side_top_panel APIs; exact_size includes panel margins.
Confirmed Divider::show returns a Response with a rect, and the routing panel uses that measured divider height.
Confirmed the header-height formula matches egui 0.34.3 CollapsingHeader sizing: button-text galley height plus vertical button padding, bounded by interact_size.
Confirmed the fixed-height budget accounts for the divider-to-routing, routing-to-header, and header-to-body item gaps.
The panel uses a two-row-plus-visible-warnings fallback before a route measurement exists, then stores the measured route-control height for subsequent frames.
When open, the options viewport targets 32 to 96 points when the remaining central height permits; it is reduced to the available remainder when less space remains.
The route and footer remain bottom-pinned. The residual central region is clipped to its remaining rect, and roster/status content uses only that area.
The existing Routing options observer and header ID are retained. Multi keyboard now observes and consumes the user action before issuing the existing profile/session mutation.
Existing start, stop, selection, Restore, close, quit, and cleanup-failure handlers remain in place.

Confirmed egui-winit 0.34.3 converts MinInnerSize using pixels_per_point, and egui computes pixels_per_point from zoom_factor times native_pixels_per_point; the existing GUI reapplies the minimum after zoom changes.
limitations: The 32-point options minimum is conditional: if the route panel leaves less space, the viewport uses that smaller remainder, which may be zero under insufficient available height.
No runtime measurement or visual assertion was performed for 320x360, opened routing options, visible warnings, or resize transitions. Independent native/UI acceptance remains necessary.
